source_checks.source: Pugliese & Fitterer 1970, Metall. Trans. 1, 1997, Table II (local copy ~/data/private/crni-sources-20261105/), checked by the coordinator
source_checks.finding: printed as 0.112, consistent with the source (the ESPEI file transcribes it faithfully); internally inconsistent with the printed cell potential (1.236 V vs 1.234 V for neighbouring alloys with a_Cr 0.98-0.99), likely a misprint in the paper
source_checks.action: flag only; data unchanged; stays in set E at its ORCHID-rule sigma (2.9 kJ/mol); fit reported with and without it only if it changes the topology

summary.1_sigma: set E: no observation at a software default (ZPF at ORCHID's rule, weight 1; ORCHID records at sigma_effective; non-ORCHID data at the ORCHID method-class 'unknown' floors). Sets C/D had Pugliese, Dench, Watson at ESPEI's 500 J/mol default.
2_within_series: Pugliese 1448 K x_Cr 0.95 a_Cr 0.112 between 0.998 and 0.99 (26 kJ/mol in RT ln gamma, 9 sigma; see source_checks)
Sudavtsova 1873 K liquid ACR: a_Cr rises from 0.1125 (x_Ni 0.787) to 0.1649 (x_Ni 0.793), non-monotonic beyond 2 sigma
Batalin 1960 K liquid HM_MIX: positive for x_Ni 0.64-0.71 within an otherwise negative series
summary.3_partial_vs_integral: Katayama 1733/1783/1833 K give H_bar_Cr = +86 to +124 kJ/mol (sigma ~73 kJ/mol from three temperatures) against -17 to +13 kJ/mol from the integral liquid HM_MIX series: 1.2-1.9 sigma, not informative.
summary.4_basis_units: Hao liquid HM_MIX per mole of atoms assumed (being checked); DFT 0 K values entered at 298.15 K; Pugliese referenced to BCC Cr, Hao ACR to liquid Cr.
summary.5_duplicates: Saltykov/Thiedemann used once; Svechnikov is a secondary digitisation; Hao Fig. 16 ZPF re-plots not used; Jette 1934 has 6 identical row pairs within its file (counted twice); set D/E (i)+(ii) observations share parents by rule.
summary.6_cross_source: liquid HM_MIX sources disagree beyond their sigmas at x_Ni 0.65 (spread 6.1 kJ/mol) and 0.75 (3.6 kJ/mol), Batalin against the others; liquid ACR at 1873 K and solid HM_FORM (Dench vs Watson) agree within sigma; ZPF FCC boundary: Jette 1934 lies 0.048 Cr-richer than the other sources within 30 K (flag), Taylor 1952 +0.030 (just below the flag).
summary.7_pull: Pugliese 1448 K x_Cr 0.95 carries 89-99 % of its dataset's chi2/2 (40 units at set E's sigma); per-point pull highest for Pugliese-3, Katayama 1833 K, Batalin, Gilby at the paper optimum.
